svg.title: Four leases move between replica-0 and replica-1 as the intervals pass
svg.desc: replica-0 owns lease 0 to lease 3. replica-1 starts, and each acquire check, 13 s apart, takes one lease until both replicas own two. Every live owner renews its leases every 17 s. replica-1 stops, its leases run down for the 60 s expiration interval and expire, and the next acquire check of replica-0 takes lease 2 and lease 3 back.

g.text: ring: time left before the lease expires
replica-0 owns all four leases of tracking-projection
replica-1 starts, and its first acquire check takes lease 3
13 s later its next check takes lease 2, so each replica owns two
replica-1 stops, so nobody renews lease 2 and lease 3 any more
60 s after their last renew, lease 2 and lease 3 expire
replica-0's next acquire check takes both leases back
